svg.title: Interclub Snooker database architecture with Notifications and Inbox
svg.desc: Existing overview followed by six notification tables. Solid arrows point from child foreign keys to parent primary keys. The announcement event-key association is dashed and is not a database constraint.

g.text: Solid arrows: child FK → parent PK. The person anchor below refers to the existing Identity & Access table.
At most one preference row per person
Idempotency: client request ID is the PK
One person: 0–1 preference row; many inbox items
One inbox item can have many delivery rows;
each delivery references one item and one device.
Only one delivery is allowed per item/device pair.
Config and announcement authors may be NULL.
All six tables have RLS enabled. Client database
roles have no grants; server APIs control access.
Notification types: fixture_change · match_reminder · lineup_reminder · ladder_challenge · announcement
Delivery status: Pending · Sending · Sent · Failed · Skipped | PK primary key · FK foreign key · UQ unique constraint
